name: token-saver
description: Token-saver mod: quiet bash, trim output, cache band, /tokens, cold-cache compaction veto

quietBash.title: Rewrite noisy bash
quietBash.description: git status/log and test commands become short reporters before they run.

trimOutput.title: Trim huge successful output
trimOutput.description: Head+tail of huge successful stdout. Failures are left intact.

cacheBand.title: Cache band above the prompt
cacheBand.description: CLI and Desktop only. VS Code panel does not draw mod UI.

compactHint.title: Cache-aware hint on the band
compactHint.description: Fat and warm: /compact is cheap. Fat and cold: /clear, do not /compact. Never types into the box.

compactGuard.title: Veto /compact on a cold cache
compactGuard.description: Manual /compact is refused when the prompt cache has gone cold, with the re-send cost named. Auto-compaction is never blocked. Override once with: /compact force

longCacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL is 1 hour
longCacheTtl.description: Off: 5-minute TTL (Claude Code's default). On: 1-hour TTL. Sets when the band and the compact guard call the cache cold.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest parked skills for this repo at session start
suggestSkills.description: Reads package.json, Package.swift, pyproject, Cargo.toml, go.mod and html for signals and names parked skills that fit. One UI line, no tokens. /park suggest [topic] on demand.
